place.note: Important Śaiva temple in Tiruviḍaimarudūr, otherwise known as Madhyārjuna. The temple is now under the control of the Tiruvavaduturai adheenam. The Maratha Bhonsle ruler Pratapasimha (r. 1739-1763) made donations of metal lamps to that temple. Several plays composed by playwrights commissioned by Maratha rulers were enacted in that temple..
